scope: Analytic and Lean recheck of the pressure-amplitude witness path into FinalSlowBase.actualProfile. No CFD simulation was run or used.

rechecked_results.exists_final_profile_data_with_pressure_: proved existentially: some ProfileData has outgoing core.P >= 2
rechecked_results.actual_profile_is_a_profile_data: proved only that the selected actualProfile has outgoing core.P > 0
rechecked_results.no_uniform_lower_bound_over_normalizatio: proved that no positive amplitude floor follows uniformly over every normalization above a finite threshold

interpretation: PreparedOutgoing carries amplitude_lower through its prepared profile and later assembly, but FinalSlowBase.ProfileData omits that witness field. profileData_nonempty separately constructs an ordinary profileData, and actualProfile is Classical.choice of that ordinary existential. The recheck confirms a provenance gap in this extension; it does not show that the selected profile violates the threshold or that the upstream theorem is false.
upstream_reporting: No issue submitted: the audited item is a limitation of this external verification bridge, not a reproduced defect in the upstream repository's stated theorem. Its issue tracker is disabled.
